title_en: Narathiwat police encircle and kill three assailants in shootout, Si Sakhon Police Station
summary_en: Police are surrounding a shootout in Ban Thong Noi, Si Sakhon district of Narathiwat. A policeman from Si Sakhon police station died on the day. Two officers were injured and three suspects have been killed.

title_en: Security checks 'S.C. Bannang Sata' base, bombers found in the area
summary_en: Security forces are on the ground to check out Bannang Sata police station after two bombs were thrown, one working and another injuring five officers. Buildings and motorcycles have been damaged.
